music: W. A. Mozart, String Quartet No. 19 in C major, K. 465, IV. Allegro molto — Musopen Kickstarter recording (CC0)
note: The movement's exposition, from its first note to its closing chord (111.144 s), under the whole film. phrases: the beat of the recording (tracked at 150 BPM) that each cut of the film lands on, chosen so that every span is stretched by about the same amount (×1.014–×1.084), the stronger attack winning; at: the film's cuts (the slides, the live pages, the summing-up and the sources), the first anchor the very start and the last the closing chord. to: where the chord's ring is cut, before the development begins.
